battle.name: 第二次馬拉塔戰爭
battle.brief: 一八〇二年浦那之戰與年末《巴森條約》之後，浦那聯盟分裂，英軍於一八〇三至一八〇五年在德干高原對馬拉塔聯軍發動戰役。阿薩耶、拉斯瓦里與阿爾岡三役定勝負，線列齊射的骨幹正是卡面的一七九五年式滑膛槍，馬拉塔方面則以馬隊砲兵、象兵與歐洲傭兵應戰。

kit.name: 一七九五年式滑膛槍
kit.history: 一七九五年式滑膛槍是英國陸軍步兵的制式火槍，廣泛配屬英軍各步兵營與東印度公司步兵，並與步槍單位的來福槍分列使用。

countries: 這場戰爭的交戰雙方，是英國東印度公司率領的英軍聯盟，以及以浦那為核心的馬拉塔聯盟。英方的指揮體系分三層：倫敦的東印度公司董事會與印度總督莫寧頓伯爵決定戰略方針與撥款；孟買總督府負責遠征軍的組建、軍需與對外交涉；前線最高指揮為拉姆爵士與威爾斯利少將，另有鮑威爾、默里、哈考特等將領分取本德爾肯德、班杜克與比哈爾。英方可用兵力合計逾五萬三千人，除英籍步兵營與騎兵團外，還有海得拉巴的尼扎姆等附庸王公提供的步兵與砲兵。馬拉塔方面是一個五家首領的聯邦：居浦那的帕什瓦、居巴羅達的他爾卡德、居瓜廖爾的斯欣達、居印多爾的霍爾卡爾、居那格浦爾的邦斯勒。各家自領步兵、騎兵與砲兵，戰時才由某一強勢首領臨時統合指揮；此外大量葡萄牙、法國、意大利與日耳曼籍傭兵與砲手在聯軍中服役，斯欣達的參謀長普爾曼即其一。兩方實力對比懸殊：英軍集中於少數訓練嚴格的線列營，火砲與後勤可控；馬拉塔騎兵與馬隊砲兵靈活，但各部互不隸屬，彈藥與指揮鏈鬆散。英方勝在集中兵力與統一火器，馬拉塔方則在於地勢熟悉、騎兵機動與持久戰的韌性。
countriesEn: The two sides in this war were the British-led East India Company alliance on one hand, and the Maratha confederacy centred on Poona on the other. The British command system had three layers: the East India Company board in London and the Governor-General of India, Lord Mornington, decided strategy and funding; the Bombay government was responsible for raising the expeditionary army, its supply and its dealings with the states; and at the front the highest command belonged to Sir Gerard Lake and Major-General Arthur Wellesley, with generals such as Powell, Murray and Harcourt taking Bundelkhand, Badoch and Bihar respectively. The British had more than fifty-three thousand men available for the campaign, made up not only of British infantry battalions and cavalry regiments but also of infantry and artillery supplied by subsidiary princes such as the Nizam of Hyderabad. The Maratha side was a confederacy of five chiefs: the Peshwa at Poona, the Gaekwad at Baroda, Scindia at Gwalior, Holkar at Indore and Bhonsle at Nagpur. Each raised his own infantry, cavalry and guns, and only a strong chief could unite them in the field for a particular operation; in addition a large number of Portuguese, French, Italian and German mercenary soldiers and gunners served in the allied army, among them Pohlmann, Scindia's chief of staff. The contrast in strength was stark. The British concentrated on a small number of rigorously trained linear battalions with controllable artillery and supply; Maratha cavalry and horse batteries were mobile, but the formations were not subordinate to one another and the chain of command and the flow of ammunition were loose. The British advantage lay in concentration and in standardised weapons; the Marathas relied on knowledge of the ground, cavalry mobility and staying power in a long contest.
people: 留下姓名的關鍵人物分屬兩營，另有幾位在幕後左右局勢。英方最上層是印度總督莫寧頓伯爵，他屢次向帕什瓦與斯欣達提出附庸條約而遭拒，最後以《巴森條約》為支點撬開馬拉塔聯盟；前線則是拉姆爵士，他率主力自北方沿恆河與朱納納河一帶南下，攻取德里與阿格拉，切斷斯欣達的北方根據地。威爾斯利少將是全戰役最關鍵的名字：他率第四師由孟買出發，同年八月連下艾哈邁德納加爾，繼而在阿薩耶以數千人破數萬人，再於阿爾岡擊敗邦斯勒，此後在半島戰爭中成為威靈頓。馬拉塔方面，帕什瓦巴吉拉奧二世是樞紐：他在浦那內鬥中暗算霍爾卡爾的親眷而與霍爾卡爾結下死仇，被霍爾卡爾在浦那之戰中打敗後逃入英方保護，一八〇二年十二月簽下《巴森條約》，自此把自己放在英國的保護之下，也把辛迪亞與邦斯勒推成公開的敵人。總理納納·法德納維斯長期拒絕附庸條約，是主戰派的核心。霍爾卡爾的雅什萬特勞在浦那之戰得勝後仍孤軍作戰，一八〇四年北走旁遮普向蘭吉特·辛格求援未果，最終因資源枯竭而求和。營以下則是各營連長與參謀：阿薩耶一役英軍傷亡約一千六百人，其中不少是在陣地上指揮射擊與收攏隊形的軍官，姓名多散見於各團的軍功紀錄與隨軍日誌。
peopleEn: The key figures whose names survive belong to two camps, with a few others pulling strings behind the scenes. At the top of the British side was the Governor-General of India, Lord Mornington, who had repeatedly offered a subsidiary treaty to the Peshwa and to Scindia and been refused, and who finally used the Treaty of Bassein as the wedge to split the Maratha confederacy; in the field the command belonged to Sir Gerard Lake, who led his main army south from the Ganges and Jumna region to seize Delhi and Agra and cut Scindia off from his northern base. The most consequential name of the war is Major-General Arthur Wellesley: he led the Fourth Division out of Bombay, took Ahmednagar in August of the same year, then beat a many-times-larger army at Assaye with a few thousand men and destroyed Bhonsle's force at Argaon, before going on to fight the Peninsular War and become the Duke of Wellington. On the Maratha side the pivot was the Peshwa Baji Rao II. He had a Holkar relative killed in the struggle inside Poona and so earned Yashwantrao Holkar's deadly enmity; when Holkar beat the combined Peshwa-Scindia army at the Battle of Poona he fled to British protection and in December 1802 signed the Treaty of Bassein, placing himself under British protection and at the same time turning Scindia and Bhonsle into open enemies. The Peshwa's minister Nana Fadnavis had long refused any subsidiary treaty and was the heart of the war party. Yashwantrao Holkar won at Poona yet had to fight on alone; in 1804 he marched north to the Punjab to seek help from Ranjit Singh, was not received, and was finally forced to make terms as his resources ran out. Below the generals were battalion commanders and staff officers: British casualties at Assaye came to about sixteen hundred, many of them officers who had been shot while standing up to direct fire or to reform their ranks, and their names are scattered through regimental honour rolls and campaign diaries.
kits: 卡面這件兵器是英國陸軍步兵在一七九五年配發的制式滑膛火槍，即通稱的褐貝絲。槍管口徑十四點六毫米，射擊點七五盎司鉛彈，褐色鋼製槍管長約四十二英寸，槍身連刺刀約一碼，淨重約四點五公斤，配可拆螺絲口的刺刀座，刺刀兼作拆卸槍管螺絲的扳手。它較一七六三年式長槍縮短槍管、加重配重，以便單手持槍與行軍，採黑火藥，每名步兵配發約六十發紙包彈藥，射速約每分鐘三至四發，精度與射速都靠線列齊射來發揮。它在體系裡的位置很清楚：它是英軍步兵營的骨幹火力，與步槍單位列裝的來福槍分開使用，後者射程較遠但射速慢，常置於縱隊之外或守備要點；一七九五年式滑膛槍同時是東印度公司步兵的標準配備，在德干作戰的英軍與印籍營都靠它維持射擊距離，滑膛槍手在兩三百步內以齊射與刺刀衝鋒收尾，步槍手則用來福槍壓制遠距目標。馬拉塔方的武器體系完全是另一路數：步兵多持土製火繩槍與短槍，冷兵器比例高；騎兵配薩別爾、標槍與火槍；砲兵以二至六磅的馬隊小砲與旋轉砲為主，由歐洲砲手操作；象兵背上架設小砲，攻城則用六、十二、二十四磅重砲與攻城塔。這套以騎兵帶砲、冷兵器為主的體系在衝鋒上凶悍，卻缺乏統一火器標準，齊射能力遠不如英軍線列。
kitsEn: The weapon on the card is the standard smoothbore flintlock musket issued to British infantry in 1795, the so-called Brown Bess. Its bore is fourteen point six millimetres, it fires a ball of three quarters of an ounce, the brown steel barrel is about forty-two inches long, the arm measures about a yard with the bayonet, and it weighs some four and a half kilograms. The bayonet socket is screw-on, and the bayonet doubles as the screwdriver used to take the barrel screw out. Compared with the long 1763 musket it has a shorter barrel and a heavier balance, so that it could be carried one-handed and on the march. It uses black powder, each infantryman carried about sixty rounds of paper ammunition, and the rate of fire was roughly three to four rounds a minute, with both accuracy and rate of fire depending on massed volleys. Its place in the order of battle is quite clear: it was the backbone firepower of the British infantry battalion, used separately from the rifles of the rifle regiments, which had greater range but slower rate of fire and were often held outside the column or on detached posts. The 1795 pattern musket was also the standard issue of East India Company infantry, and both British and Indian companies fighting in the Deccan depended on it to hold the enemy at shooting distance: the musketeers closed with volleys and the bayonet at two or three hundred paces, while the riflemen worked on distant targets. The Maratha weapon system was a completely different affair. Their infantry carried home-made matchlocks and short guns, with a high proportion of cold weapons; cavalry had sabres, lances and matchlocks; their artillery was made up of light two- to six-pounder horse guns and swivel pieces worked by European gunners; elephants carried small guns on their backs; and for sieges they used six-, twelve- and twenty-four-pounder heavy guns and siege towers. This system of cavalry-borne light guns and cold weapons was ferocious in the charge, but it had no standard of ordnance and nothing like the volley capacity of the British line.
tactics: 英軍的戰術骨架是線列與齊射。步兵營以連為單位排成兩線，第一線跪射、第二線立射，營長一聲令下整營同時開火，數百支一七九五年式滑膛槍在數秒內傾瀉彈雨；每營兩端派出側翼警戒分隊，防止騎兵迂迴。騎兵以連為單位在正面展開，掩護砲兵與彈藥車，同時把敵軍騎兵牽制在陣前，等於用速度換取英軍的射擊時間。阿薩耶的過程最能說明這套打法的短處與長處：英軍左翼警戒分隊被馬拉塔騎兵切斷，十九輕騎團幾乎被圍殲，參謀部與樂隊也被卷入混戰，威爾斯利下令以第四師步兵與砲車組成密集方陣，把殘部與火砲救出，隨後反擊才把戰局扳回來。與此同時，馬拉塔聯軍兵力雖眾，卻因各部互不配合而無法集中，往往只以數千騎兵反覆衝擊英軍側後與通信線，砲兵雖多卻缺乏射擊紀律。拉斯瓦里是另一種樣貌：拉姆的主力以砲兵與騎兵協同，把斯欣達的騎兵縱隊引入有利射界再行反擊。攻堅方面，艾哈邁德納加爾的外牆被砲火打成缺口，步兵隨缺口突入；阿爾岡則以縱隊猛攻堡壘。整體而言，英軍靠嚴格的線列、齊射、火砲集中與通信秩序取勝，馬拉塔方靠騎兵機動、遊擊與熟悉地形抵抗。
tacticsEn: The skeleton of British tactics was the line and the volley. Infantry battalions were drawn up in two lines by company, the first line kneeling and the second standing, and on the battalion commander's order the whole battalion fired at once, several hundred 1795 pattern muskets emptying their cartridges into the enemy within seconds; flank parties were detached at both ends of each battalion to guard against cavalry turning the line. Cavalry was deployed in company frontage on the forward side, screening the guns and the ammunition wagons and holding the enemy cavalry in front of the infantry, in effect trading speed for the time the British needed to shoot. The course of the fighting at Assaye shows the strengths and the weaknesses of that system better than anything else. The British flank detachment was cut off by Maratha cavalry, the 19th Light Dragoons were very nearly annihilated, and the staff and the band were drawn into the melee; Wellesley then ordered infantry of the Fourth Division and the guns to form a close body, cleared the survivors and the artillery, and only the counter-attack afterwards turned the battle. At the same time the Maratha army, huge as it was, could not concentrate because its parts did not work together: often only a few thousand horsemen were thrown again and again at the British rear and at the line of communication, and although their guns were numerous they lacked firing discipline. Laswari wore a different shape, with Lake's main army combining artillery and cavalry so as to draw Scindia's cavalry columns into a favourable field of fire before counter-attacking. On the offensive side the outer wall of Ahmednagar was opened by artillery fire and the infantry went in through the breach, while Argaon was assaulted by columns storming the works. Taken as a whole, the British won through strict linear formation, massed volleys, concentrated artillery and an orderly system of communication, while the Marathas resisted through cavalry mobility, irregular warfare and their intimate knowledge of the ground.
data: 可核對的數字大致如下，但不同史家記載多有出入。英方在一八〇三年投入的總兵力，維基百科引述的說法是可用兵力逾五萬三千人；威爾斯利在完成後勤集結後麾下為約二萬四千人，其中第四師是作戰主力。阿薩耶一役，常見的說法是英軍投入約四千五百人，含英籍步兵約一千五百人、印籍步兵約二千人、騎兵約一千人，火砲六門六磅砲與兩門榴彈砲；馬拉塔聯軍總兵力約四萬至五萬人，火砲逾百門，但實際投入交戰者僅數千人，陣亡與被俘者估計以數千計。英軍傷亡約一千六百人，其中多為傷者。距離與日期方面，阿薩耶距孟買約八十八公里，一八〇三年八月八日英軍攻取艾哈邁德納加爾的外城，同年八月十二日堡壘在砲火造成的缺口後投降；一八〇三年十月十八日英軍以僅二死五傷的代價攻取阿西爾伽堡的市郊；十一月二十九日英軍在阿爾岡擊敗邦斯勒的軍隊。火器數據方面，一七九五年式滑膛槍口徑十四點六毫米，槍管四十二英寸，連刺刀長約一碼，淨重約四點五公斤，每兵配彈約六十發，射速約每分鐘三至四發。割地數字也值得記錄：一八〇三年十二月十七日《德奧岡條約》割讓卡塔克等奧里薩地區，十二月三十日《蘇爾吉-安讓岡條約》割讓希薩爾、帕尼帕特、羅塔克、列瓦里、古爾岡、恆河與亞穆納河間地帶、德里至阿格拉區、部分本德爾肯德、古吉拉特若干區與艾哈邁德納加爾堡；一八〇五年十二月二十四日《拉吉哈特條約》再從霍爾卡爾手中取得通克、蘭普拉與文迪。時間上，戰爭自一八〇二年浦那之戰後起，至一八〇五年底收束，前後約三年。
dataEn: The verifiable figures are roughly as follows, though different historians differ on many of them. On the total British commitment in 1803, the figure given in the encyclopaedic account is more than fifty-three thousand men available; once his logistic assembly was complete Wellesley commanded about twenty-four thousand men, of whom the Fourth Division was the striking force. At Assaye the usual account is that the British committed about four thousand five hundred men, comprising some fifteen hundred British infantry, about two thousand Indian infantry and about a thousand cavalry, with six six-pounder guns and two howitzers; the Maratha confederate army numbered perhaps forty to fifty thousand men with more than a hundred guns, but only some thousands were actually engaged, and the killed and captured are estimated in the thousands. British casualties came to about sixteen hundred, the great majority of them wounded. As for distances and dates, Assaye lies about eighty-eight kilometres from Bombay; on 8 August 1803 the British took the walled pettah of Ahmednagar, and on 12 August the fort itself surrendered after a breach made by artillery fire; on 18 October 1803 the pettah of Asirgarh was taken at a cost of two dead and five wounded; and on 29 November the British destroyed Bhonsle's army at Argaon. On the weapons themselves, the 1795 pattern musket had a bore of fourteen point six millimetres, a barrel of forty-two inches, a length of about a yard with the bayonet, a weight of some four and a half kilograms, an issue of roughly sixty rounds per man and a rate of fire of about three to four rounds a minute. The territorial figures are worth recording as well: the Treaty of Deogaon of 17 December 1803 ceded Cuttack and the other Odisha districts, and the Treaty of Surji-Anjangaon of 30 December 1803 ceded Hisar, Panipat, Rohtak, Rewari, Gurgaon, the Ganges-Jumna Doab, the Delhi-Agra region, part of Bundelkhand, districts of Gujarat and the fort of Ahmednagar; the Treaty of Rajghat of 24 December 1805 then took Tonk, Rampura and Bundi from Holkar. In time, the war ran from the Battle of Poona in 1802 to the end of 1805, a matter of about three years.
cause: 打起來的原因，可以分成遠因、近因與導火線三層。遠因是英國在印度完成對邁索爾的征服之後，轉而把南亞大陸內陸納入自己的勢力範圍。一八〇〇年前後，馬拉塔聯盟的五家首領——浦那的帕什瓦、巴羅達的他爾卡德、瓜廖爾的斯欣達、印多爾的霍爾卡爾、那格浦爾的邦斯勒——彼此爭權，名義上以帕什瓦為首，事實上各領一方；莫寧頓伯爵屢次提出的附庸條約，就是要在這片內陸建立英國的駐軍與否決權。近因是帕什瓦本人：巴吉拉奧二世在浦那內鬥中暗算霍爾卡爾的親眷，與霍爾卡爾結下死仇，一八〇二年十月，他與斯欣達的聯軍在浦那被霍爾卡爾打敗，只好逃入英方保護。導火線則是一八〇二年十二月三十一日的《巴森條約》，帕什瓦向英方割地、供應駐軍費用，並承諾不與任何其他國家另行結約。對英方而言這是一紙插入馬拉塔聯盟內部的楔子，對辛迪亞與邦斯勒而言則是共主體面的背叛。於是斯欣達取道北方攻入德里地區，邦斯勒據布拉索爾與那格浦爾，霍爾卡爾控制德干西路，聯盟原本的內向結構轉為對英的全面抵抗。
causeEn: The reasons for the fighting divide into a remote cause, a proximate cause and a trigger. The remote cause is that once the British had completed the conquest of Mysore they turned to drawing the interior of the South Asian landmass into their own sphere. Around 1800 the five chiefs of the Maratha confederacy, the Peshwa of Poona, the Gaekwad of Baroda, Scindia of Gwalior, Holkar of Indore and Bhonsle of Nagpur, were quarrelling among themselves, nominally headed by the Peshwa but in fact each ruling his own ground, and the subsidiary treaties that Lord Mornington kept proposing were an attempt to establish British troops and a British veto over that interior. The proximate cause is the Peshwa himself: Baji Rao II had a relative of Holkar's killed in the struggle inside Poona and so earned Yashwantrao Holkar's deadly enmity, and in October 1802 his army, combined with Scindia's, was beaten at Poona by Holkar and he was driven to seek British protection. The trigger was the Treaty of Bassein of 31 December 1802, by which the Peshwa ceded territory, undertook to maintain the subsidiary force, and promised to make no treaty with any other power. To the British this was a wedge driven into the heart of the Maratha confederacy; to Scindia and Bhonsle it was a betrayal of the common overlord. Scindia struck north into the Delhi region, Bhonsle held Bhusawal and Nagpur, and Holkar controlled the western roads of the Deccan, and the confederacy's inward-facing structure turned into open resistance against the British.
impact: 戰後的結果不只是版圖變化，而是整套南亞權力結構被改寫。第一，馬拉塔聯盟作為一個能對外作戰的軍事集團從此瓦解：帕什瓦被安置在英方保護之下，斯欣達、邦斯勒與霍爾卡爾各自退守封地，德干與北印度的軍事主權落到東印度公司手中；通行的說法把《巴森條約》直接稱為馬拉塔帝國的喪鐘。第二，馬拉塔的戰術體系被貶值：過去半個世紀威震南亞的馬隊砲兵與輕騎遊擊，在線列步兵與制式火器面前不再有效，此後數十年裡，馬拉塔諸軍的砲兵漸漸淪為象兵與象乘砲的陳設式殘餘，獨立的馬拉塔軍事傳統逐步消亡。第三，歐洲傭兵系統走到終點：普爾曼、佩隆這類服務於斯欣達的外籍指揮官戰敗之後回到歐洲，法國在印度的軍事影響自此中斷。第四，英國在南亞的統治從邊緣貿易點變成內陸宗主：英軍在德里、阿格拉與德干建立常駐部隊，附庸條約的網逐步罩住每一個印度王公，此一結構一直延續到一八五八年英王直接接管印度為止。第五，後續的歷史走向被這場戰爭決定：霍爾卡爾的勢力退守拉賈斯坦與馬爾瓦，馬拉塔餘部於一八一七至一八一八年的第三次英國-馬拉塔戰爭中被徹底清除，南亞內陸此後再沒有能與英國抗衡的本土軍事強權。
impactEn: What followed was not merely a change in the map but a rewriting of the whole structure of power in South Asia. First, the Maratha confederacy ceased to exist as a military grouping capable of waging war abroad: the Peshwa was settled under British protection, Scindia, Bhonsle and Holkar were each confined to their own territories, and the military sovereignty of the Deccan and northern India passed to the East India Company; the Treaty of Bassein is commonly called the death knell of the Maratha Empire. Second, the Maratha way of war was devalued. The horse batteries and light cavalry raids that had terrorised South Asia for half a century no longer worked against linear infantry with standardised weapons, and over the decades that followed the Maratha artillery sank into a ceremonial residue of elephants and elephant guns, while the independent Maratha military tradition gradually disappeared. Third, the European mercenary system ran its course to the end: officers like Pohlmann and Perron, who had served Scindia, returned to Europe after their defeat, and French military influence in India came to an end with them. Fourth, British rule in South Asia changed from a matter of trading posts on the fringe to an overlordship of the interior: the British established permanent garrisons at Delhi, Agra and in the Deccan, and the web of subsidiary treaties gradually closed over every Indian prince, a structure that ran on until the Crown assumed direct control of India in 1858. Fifth, the future course of history was settled by this war: Holkar's power fell back into Rajputana and Malwa, and the remaining Maratha forces were finally swept away in the Third Anglo-Maratha War of 1817 to 1818, after which no indigenous military power in the South Asian interior could again stand against the British.
result: 直接結果是英國的全面勝利與馬拉塔聯盟的解體。一八〇三年八月威爾斯利以二萬四千人集結之師連下艾哈邁德納加爾，把英軍的根據地推到戈達瓦里河一線；九月在阿薩耶擊敗斯欣達與邦斯勒聯軍，拉姆同時在德里擊敗斯欣達的守軍，德里與阿格拉落入英軍之手；十一月拉斯瓦里再勝，十一月二十九日阿爾岡之役打垮邦斯勒的主力。十二月十七日邦斯勒簽《德奧岡條約》，十二月三十日斯欣達簽《蘇爾吉-安讓岡條約》，割地與入朝覲見的名分就此確定。霍爾卡爾是唯一把戰事拖到一八〇五年的一方，他以遊擊襲擾英軍通信線，一度還指望辛迪亞的支援，但辛迪亞已簽約；他北走旁遮普向蘭吉特·辛格求援而未果，兵員與彈藥耗盡，最後在英軍於一八〇四年四月主動發動攻勢的壓力下求和，一八〇五年十二月二十四日《拉吉哈特條約》割讓通克、蘭普拉與文迪。就全局而言，一八〇二年十月浦那之戰確立了霍爾卡爾的強勢，也確立了馬拉塔聯盟從此只能各自求存的分裂；到一八〇五年底，德干與北印度的門戶盡入英國之手，馬拉塔帝國作為南亞內陸強權的時代結束。這場戰爭的成色，也體現在一件兵器上：一七九五年式滑膛槍在英軍線列裡所扮演的角色，正是這場勝局最直接的技術原因之一。
resultEn: The immediate result was a complete British victory and the dissolution of the Maratha confederacy. In August 1803 Wellesley, with his twenty-four thousand men assembled, took Ahmednagar in succession and pushed the British base down to the line of the Godavari; in September he beat the allied army of Scindia and Bhonsle at Assaye, while at the same moment Lake defeated Scindia's garrison at Delhi, so that Delhi and Agra fell to the British; Laswari brought another victory in November, and the battle of Argaon on 29 November destroyed the main body of Bhonsle's army. On 17 December Bhonsle signed the Treaty of Deogaon and on 30 December Scindia signed the Treaty of Surji-Anjangaon, and with them the cession of territory and the precedent of imperial audience were settled. Holkar was the only one to drag the war on into 1805. He harried the British lines of communication by irregular warfare and had expected help from Scindia, who had already signed away; he marched north to the Punjab to seek Ranjit Singh and was not received, his men and ammunition ran out, and in the end he sued for peace under the pressure of a British offensive opened in April 1804, ceding Tonk, Rampura and Bundi in the Treaty of Rajghat of 24 December 1805. Taken as a whole, the Battle of Poona of October 1802 established Holkar's strength and equally established the split that left the Maratha confederacy thereafter a collection of self-preserving powers; by the end of 1805 the gates of the Deccan and of northern India lay open to the British, and the age of the Maratha Empire as an inland power in South Asia was over. The character of the war is also legible in a single weapon: the part played by the 1795 pattern musket in the British line was one of the most direct technical causes of that victory.
